kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انهمرت (form VII)
# اِنْهَمَرْتُ (inhamartu) /in.ha.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# اِنْهَمَرْتَ (inhamarta) /in.ha.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# اِنْهَمَرْتِ (inhamarti) /in.ha.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# اِنْهَمَرَتْ (inhamarat) /in.ha.ma.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
